confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors are central estimates for July peak-season prices, drawn from 2025-2026 travel and cost guides and one crowd-sourced index. Those sources conflict (for example beer EUR 3-6, cocktail EUR 8-15), and no menu prices were verified. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Split summer seasonality; no booking pages or live listings were inspected. EUR is converted to USD at an assumed 1.16 USD per EUR from general knowledge, not a retrieved rate, so every USD anchor moves with that assumption. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026) comes from search-result text of the RBA exchange rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink anchors use Split-specific 2026 guide ranges, with July peak-season pricing applied. Expatistan cost-of-living comparisons place Split roughly level with Prague and below Lisbon, used as a general price-level cross-check. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of peak-July pricing in Adriatic coastal resort cities of similar size.
